# VAppCloud Provider

Manage VAppCloud resources. Organization service tokens are exchanged for short-lived API JWTs and are never persisted in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"
  required_providers {
    vappcloud = {
      source  = "vappcloud/vappcloud"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "vappcloud" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) VAppCloud API base URL. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_API_URL`, then `https://api.4lock.net`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) VAppCloud organization service token. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_TOKEN`.
